title: Task fields in PocketBase: id, title, description, status, assigned_agent, reassignment_count
body: Task records in PocketBase include: id (string), title, description, status ('todo'|'in_progress'|'peer_review'|'approved'|'blocked'|'backlog'|'waiting_human'), assigned_agent, goal_id, gh_issue_id, required_skills (array), reassignment_count (int), last_reassignment_at (datetime), scratchpad, github_repo, github_issue_url, created, updated.
source_ref: facts.db:tasks PRAGMA table_info; AGENTS/RULES.md Kanban section
